seltz.title: Why You Should Think Twice About Hiring a Virtual Assistant if You’re a Solopreneur | Marvelous
seltz.snippet:
*“Are you starting an online business? Or eager to take your existing business to the next level? If so, you MUST hire a virtual assistant (VA).” *

Or, at least, that’s what we were told back when we first launched our company.

At the start of our entrepreneurial journey, we bought into the hype, hired out dozens of administrative tasks, and assumed we were on the right track.

**But recently, we’ve streamlined our team and taken over jobs once delegated to virtual assistants, contractors, and agencies. It has been THE VERY BEST decision we could have made for our business.**

We call this process “insourcing,” and although we naively thought we’d coined the term, it turns out to be a well-studied business phenomenon.

## What is insourcing?

Insourcing is a great option for entrepreneurs and solopreneurs looking to bring services in-house.

It's the opposite of outsourcing, where you would pay external contractors to provide a service instead.

Some benefits of insourcing include:

- You can maintain greater control over your services, allowing you to customize and tailor it exactly to your liking.

- You won’t need to worry about extra costs such as taxes and added fees associated with outsourced services.

Insourcing has gained some traction in big business over the last decade.
